scope: controlled synthetic clips composed from labeled LFW identity pairs; NOT doorway footage

source.identity_rule: a same-identity LFW pair is one person; the second identity is a different pair whose cosine to the first is <0.15
source.cross_identity_cosine: identity fixed by pair construction; cross-identity cosine -0.0333 (<0.15)

clip_builder: scenario_build.py (640x480, 12 fps, mp4v; faces pasted at fixed position)
harness: scenario_eval.py (legacy dnn detector+decode, 5-point SFace alignment, FaceTracker confirm=3 / TTL=2s, AnonymousAssociator tau=0.45 delta=0.10 quality<=0.10)
limitations: synthetic still-image composites, not a doorway video
LFW is research-use only; images stay in the ignored datasets/ directory
quality values sit near the 0.10 enrollment gate, so this checks association semantics more than enrollment
one identity pair only: no ambiguity case yet
